summary: Master Microsoft Azure with our Fundamentals Training Course. Learn key concepts and practical skills to enhance your cloud expertise and career opportunities.
lede: Azure fundamentals training introduces the core services and operating decisions used to manage cloud workloads. It is for cloud and systems professionals who need to select services and organize resources without advanced programming or production-scale architecture experience. Learners practice structuring resources, assigning access, comparing compute and storage options, and using monitoring and cost information to guide operational decisions.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who need to work effectively with Microsoft Azure services, cloud operating decisions, and technical stakeholders without requiring advanced programming or production-scale architecture experience.
prerequisites: No coding or programming is required for completion. You need general IT literacy and a working awareness of servers, networks, identity, applications, and data storage. The labs use guided Azure portal workflows and supplied scenarios, so advanced scripting, production deployment access, and prior Azure administration are not required.
